non_negotiable: Live Doxa display tests must be local, temporary, primary-display-safe, and independently auto-restored. The AI may provide guidance only.

scenarios.label: Temporarily disable one Doxa display
scenarios.expected_fault: One Doxa Windows display disappears temporarily; primary laptop remains active
scenarios.expected_recovery: Independent watchdog restores the exact prior Windows display configuration after the specified delay; operator can also restore from the saved snapshot
scenarios.test_question: One external Doxa monitor disappeared; help me identify it and recover the four-screen layout.

scenarios.label: Simulate missing Doxa panel
scenarios.expected_fault: Read-only diagnostic overlay for a missing Doxa screen, with actual display unchanged
scenarios.expected_recovery: Exit simulation and re-run Detect Doxa
scenarios.test_question: A Doxa panel is missing in a simulation. Walk through safe recovery steps.

scenarios.label: Simulate missing display driver
scenarios.expected_fault: Diagnostic says the display driver is missing; installed signed vendor driver is untouched
scenarios.expected_recovery: Explain Windows signed-driver checks and escalation, then reset simulation

scenarios.label: Simulate organization policy blocking installation
scenarios.expected_fault: Permission / policy failure reported in diagnostic fixture
scenarios.expected_recovery: Explain permitted IT escalation; do not bypass policy

scenarios.label: Simulate corrupt or incorrect installer package
scenarios.expected_fault: Package integrity mismatch in diagnostic overlay
scenarios.expected_recovery: Recommend signed original installer and checksum validation; never disable safety checks

scenarios.label: Simulate online Doxa support unavailable
scenarios.expected_fault: Remote support not available in diagnostic fixture
scenarios.expected_recovery: Offline verified Doxa help remains available

scenarios.label: Disconnect and reconnect Doxa USB data cable
scenarios.run: Physical operator only: leave Doxa power connected, unplug data USB-C, ask Doxa Help, reconnect.
scenarios.expected_fault: Doxa USB controller or all external displays disappear
scenarios.expected_recovery: Reconnect original data USB-C, allow Windows reenumeration, click Detect Doxa; no signed driver removal

scenarios.label: Turn off Online AI in the installer
scenarios.run: Click Offline help in the Doxa Help panel. No network or device change.
scenarios.expected_fault: Cloud assistance deliberately disabled for the user
scenarios.expected_recovery: Offline curated help continues; re-enable online AI only with fresh consent
